steps.action: Try again and pay

start: Member app, My membership, the gym asked for dues by Send to their app; set-up: old saved data in the new version

steps.action: With Payment request saved by the old version, update the app, then do "Online payments".
user_sees: The old Payment request shown in full, with the same values as before the update
must_not: Old Payment request missing, shown with empty or wrong fields, or changed without the user doing anything

steps.action: Open the request
user_sees: 'Scan this QR with any UPI app.'
'After you pay, the gym saves your receipt.'

steps.action: Tap Pay by UPI app, pay, come back
must_not: Paid shown before the money came
Old Payment request missing, shown with empty or wrong fields, or changed without the user doing anything

note: An open request made before the app update still opens
